translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Wok fakudin kinim imi sung.

Kale adikum sok gei tabamin kinim taw imi Yesus aket kudawsiw, ika ilim tabalasewal imi dakbu akfak tem bom nadiwe ilim mit tem tadiwo kinim so mak Got win so num kukubuw so uyo weng fine bakomamodiw banim keidin kala.

Kale sok gei tabamin kinim taw imi tabalasew ayo Got aket kudawsa kinim namti, ika bako, nulum muksidon buyo kale am wok iyo balut balutin bá, afan ika aket fukan dá, au aka Got aket kudawsa kinim kale bako, naka aket kudawsi, kale naka am wok uyo kidela fakudaw bidino ufek ufek kidel uyo maek tade muk. Kale wok kidel ki fakámin kala.
Kale Nulum Kamok Yesus Kadais ayo Got kukuw kidel uyo kukuyam bom sawa kidel bakayamsa uyo kanamom kinim mak tad ibako kukuw makik makik kukuya bom

alam win kufá bom keiba, kata alam kal keimin uta atin banim. Kale kanaba kinim am aket fukanin bo mafak ki, kayo Yesus weng mit uyo ilel bom wengal fukan bom kawákal titiyámin so yakanáleng kalin so kinim atafimin so weng falak tei dok didawámin so umi kukuw uyo matam tademala.

Kale kanamin kukuw fakudin kinim aka am aket fukanin uyo kidel so mak keidomu banim ade afan weng uyo am kidin tem bomu banim, kale am aket Got yán aboyámin kukuw bude kana bomo matam kisol kayakim keiyámin kaí, kale kanamala.
Kale bo afan Got yán aboyámin kukuw bo ken kinim be dakodawa matam kisol kayak keiyámin, kata alam ufek ufek faku be uyo alam aket keno kalom nadano kuw ko.
Nuka nulum neiniw mat temo mitabesuduw ayo wataw so mak dew tasuwe? Atin bá. Ade bakan kadák teinámin uyo kudálum kalokabuw ukal wataw so mak kudew unokabuwe? Atin bá.
Kata nuka wanin wanin so ilim kál so mak fakubuduw namti, buta kuw faku keno, kalin ko.

Kata yak kan kinim im aket nuka kisol yak so kudulumo, kalbiw, ika uta ta bom aket tako imadew yak abil sangadet im tam gidokaba ade ufek ufek mafak aket wananbudu um aket ki aket lulelule audokabiw. Kale kal atin im mafak dádokabu.

Kala kaleyo kisol umi aket wananyamin umi mit ayo mew adikum kukuw mafak mit, kale kinim madik iyo kisol aket wananyam budu ta bom nadiwade ilim aket afano kalin uyo kuwo mul tei nadiwade ilim aket fau bom nadiwade amanin seng keim unbiw kala.

Kata kaba Got ami kinim kale kanamin kukuw bula atin ibik wakumam uyak kaek abe nadawe kinim kidelok keibaw kuw, atin Got taw kinim abem kei nadawade aket afano kale nadawade aket kudawa kudawin uyo faku nadawade idum tade bu uyo kuek di kufi une kufi une bom nadawade fibu bom kanodin kukuw kidel uyo kudew tabal kala.

Kale kidela gadel tabe kinim biyaku tow win keidono, kanaba taw kabal kidela Yesus yán abo ta bom nadawo tow sun biyámin uyo win kei kudulal kala. Kale dil Got gán dákam sun biyámin uyo kudulalo, kaka, kalam afan kalin uyo wanang so kinim so kin dim kal kuw misun teisaw make.
Got mew ufek ufek adikum umi sinik mit kayak so Kadais Yesus Bantias Bailet alew im kin dim kadák kin walamin weng kidel bakose so im kin dim kadákal naka kitid weng bakakabi.
Kale kaba sawa bela atin ulum kano abo nadawade um weng fákam banim dew faku nadiwade asadawo Kamok Yesus Kadais ami am dánámin misunuk kala, Kale am misunokaba uyo
Got alam am dánámin ulum atan keibudune, kal misunokabano kalbu. Kale Got ata ki kin modin kinim ade ata ki kamok kamok imi Kamokim ade ata ki gebom gebom imi Gebom.

Kale alafin ata kuw Motabid Got ade aka atan eidin dukum kinim yak mewso unodiw banim taw kal biyába ade aka kinim so mak atamsiw bá ade kinim so mak atamodiw banim. Kale Got alafin ata kuw win dukum. Kale kaba win dukum kufádábadaw ade ami kitid ayo ulum kanom sun kuw bu kala. Kale afan ko.

Kaleyo yak kinim bakan kadák kisol kayak keibidiw iyo kitid weng bakoyamaw, nuta kayo, kale ilim win kufámin uyo kudá nadiwe ilim mimin dok kisol win tabin diyámin uyo bokabu bá, kata mimin dok Got ata didawin kala. Kale Got ata kuw yaknámin ufek ufek iwabidiw uyo kikiw keiyam im isom dakáyamin kinim kale aka kanodin ufek ufek bula kuyam kano kalfal bom fakámino, yakeisa.
Kale kaba weng sawa dauyamaw kukuw kidel kuw faku bom nadiwe sun kuw kukuw kidel kuw kudew tabe nadiwade kinim isom kei gelemámin kala.

Kale ika kanamin kukuw be kanamokabiw namti, ika abid tikin kal kisol kayak keidumo, kale ilim kisol ifebiw, be abid tikin abin abák kitid keidokabu. Kale be kano nadiwo ilim sun biyámin uyo kudulokabiw, kale be atin biyámin tatun uta ka.

Timoti kaba, Got ufek ufek bamadá kudákama yak kalamal abesu uyo kidela kin mo nadawe kinim imi weng tatun kanamá bom weng mit banim Got amiyo tadebu bá, umi kalan wengal kalbiw uyo kaba yakso unemin bá. Kale ika ufek ufek kukum uta bako, “bo kal keimino,” kalbiw, kata bo atin afan kal keimin bá uta ko.
Kaleyo ika bako nadiw, “nuka kal keimin fakubuduwo,” kalesiw uta kanamon nadiwe ilim aket afano kalin uyo ituwa kudásidiw ko. Got ami min gelemin uyo kabalawso badano kala.
